capability_profile.t1: nullable one-column signed-i32 table with insert/select/update/delete and predicates
capability_profile.t2: independent t2(y INTEGER PRIMARY KEY) with explicit unique signed-i32 insertion and membership
capability_profile.t3_unique: non-NULL signed-i32 values are unique; duplicate insertion returns -5; multiple NULL rows are allowed
cross_table_sum_membership: SELECT <signed-i32-or-lowercase-null> [NOT] IN (SELECT x+y FROM t1, t2)
capability_profile.cross_table_sum_semantics: evaluates the populated t1 by t2 Cartesian product, propagates t1 NULL rows, and prevents out-of-range mathematical sums from spuriously matching wrapped signed-i32 operands
capability_profile.decimal_literal_membership: signed decimal literals with one to six digits after the decimal point support IN and NOT IN against an empty list, t1, or SELECT * FROM t1
capability_profile.decimal_semantics: integral decimals compare to signed-i32 rows; fractional and out-of-range decimals cannot match; t1 NULL rows preserve three-valued membership semantics
capability_profile.text_literal_membership: empty or letter-led unescaped ASCII text and optional-minus integer text support IN and NOT IN against an empty list, t1, or SELECT * FROM t1
capability_profile.text_affinity_semantics: ordinary text cannot match integer rows; signed-integer text receives SQLite-compatible INTEGER affinity and can match t1 values; out-of-range integer text cannot match; t1 NULL rows preserve three-valued semantics
capability_profile.blob_literal_membership: valid x'...' and X'...' hexadecimal blob literals support IN and NOT IN against an empty list, t1, or SELECT * FROM t1
capability_profile.blob_semantics: blob literals cannot match integer rows; empty and populated blobs preserve SQLite three-valued membership semantics when t1 contains NULL; odd-length or non-hex payloads are rejected
capability_profile.table_independence: t1, t2, and t3 have independent schema flags, counts, capacity, values, and reset behavior
capability_profile.persistence: snapshot format version 3 atomically stores and restores all three schema flags and tables, including t1/t3 NULL flags
capability_profile.snapshot_compatibility: unchanged from sequence 12; sequence-12 through sequence-16 version-3 snapshots are mutually compatible

errors.-3: table row capacity reached; this check precedes duplicate validation
errors.-4: row or result index out of bounds
errors.-5: duplicate non-NULL t2 primary key or t3 unique value
errors.-10: unsupported or malformed SQL, unsupported t2 NULL insertion, or invalid input/snapshot

known_grammar_limits: INSERT NULL currently requires uppercase NULL, while the pinned scalar-expression family uses lowercase null
top-level row projection is SELECT x FROM t1; top-level SELECT * FROM t1 is unsupported
SELECT * is accepted in the declared membership subquery forms
decimal literals require digits on both sides of the point and one to six fractional digits; exponent notation is unsupported
text literals support empty strings, letter-led unescaped ASCII text, and optional-minus integer text; embedded quotes and other numeric-looking text forms are unsupported
blob literals require x or X followed by a quoted even-length hexadecimal payload
unsupported_t3_behavior: schemas other than exactly t3(z INTEGER UNIQUE)
broader_unsupported_database_features: tables other than t1, t2, and t3
cross-table expressions other than the declared t1.x+t2.y membership family; ordering, grouping, general joins, aggregates, indexes, general constraints, and transactions
stored floating-point, text, and blob values; general floating-point and text expressions

three_table_sqlite_differential.coverage: random populated t1, t2, and t3 states; direct-table and SELECT * subquery RHS forms; signed-i32 and NULL left operands

coverage: mixed nullable t1/t3 rows and unique t2/t3 values
bad magic, short images, and trailing bytes
